title: Some Locators
description: Simple mod that adds a better version of a lodestone compass and bit more, so i can finally stop using those chunky map mods! (I love lodestones)
body:
**Some Locators** is a simple mod that takes idea of lodestone compasses and extends it's functionality a little.
### Mod adds two new items:
- **Locator** - this is extended version of a lodestone compass that can store multiple points at once! 
  
  ![locator_crafting_recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a23650d03a152bb979503f5a483be13ebee941a2.png)
- **Player Locator** - this another type of a locator, that can track players for limited amounts of time and without showing exact direction, no matter if they have invisibility, sneaking or in another dimension (locator will show it). Also it worth noticing that if locator shows error texture **that's normal behavior!** It's just indicatets that player probably not on the server. 
  
  ![player_locator_crafting_recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/65d65378fffbbe1dbb1b26c6f648e62aae12c631.png)
